stem: At prescription intake, a pharmacist discovers that the wrong strength was dispensed yesterday and the patient may still be taking it. What is the immediate priority?

choices.text: Complete root-cause analysis before contacting anyone if its alternate trigger can be documented.
Notify the patient or representative, give correction and harm-minimization directions, and contact the prescriber when professionally indicated.
Notify only the prescriber and wait for instructions before contacting the patient.
Document within 24 hours but defer corrective directions until then.
Report every QRE to the Board before assisting the patient.

explanation.core_reasoning: 'Notify the patient or representative, give correction and harm-minimization directions, and contact the prescriber when professionally indicated.' is the governing result. By contrast, 'Complete root-cause analysis before contacting anyone.' would require that the regulation allowed later analysis to precede immediate harm-minimization duties. The decisive cue appears in 'At prescription intake, a pharmacist discovers that the wrong strength was dispensed yesterday and the patient may still be taking it. What is the immediate priority?'.

choice_analysis.A: 'Complete root-cause analysis before contacting anyone.' would apply only if the regulation allowed later analysis to precede immediate harm-minimization duties; 'At prescription intake, a pharmacist discovers that the wrong strength was dispensed yesterday and the patient may still be taking it. What is the immediate priority?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.B: 'Notify the patient or representative, give correction and harm-minimization directions, and contact the prescriber when professionally indicated.': supported by qre notification.
choice_analysis.C: 'Notify only the prescriber and wait for instructions before contacting the patient.' would apply only if the patient-notification duty were conditional on prescriber direction; 'At prescription intake, a pharmacist discovers that the wrong strength was dispensed yesterday and the patient may still be taking it. What is the immediate priority?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.D: 'Document within 24 hours but defer corrective directions until then.' would apply only if the documentation deadline also delayed immediate protective action; 'At prescription intake, a pharmacist discovers that the wrong strength was dispensed yesterday and the patient may still be taking it. What is the immediate priority?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.E: 'Report every QRE to the Board before assisting the patient.' would apply only if all QREs were automatically Board-reportable and reporting came first; 'At prescription intake, a pharmacist discovers that the wrong strength was dispensed yesterday and the patient may still be taking it. What is the immediate priority?' states otherwise.

related_facts: On discovery of a quality-related event, the pharmacist must immediately notify the patient or representative, notify the prescriber when professionally indicated, and give corrective and harm-minimization directions.
